_comment: Which ISPs get a knocking workbook, and the Drive folder name for each. Ownership of a DOOR is decided by its SalesRabbit import batch (data/isp-imports.json, kept by scripts/isp-registry.mjs), not by these states/cities: those are only the fallback for rep-created doors in a zip nobody has imported into. See scripts/isp_territory.py. Names match the folders in Drive > Grow - Corporate > Reporting > SalesRabbit Reports For ISPs.
_editing: Add a state to a list and the next report picks it up. Nothing to redeploy.

i3._note: Illinois minus Surf's Braidwood-area towns, added Sep 18 2026. Stated as an exclusion so a NEW i3 town still lands on i3's report on its own. If Surf takes another IL town, add it here AND to Surf's cities.

GBN._note: Indiana minus Surf's towns. GBN is Shelbyville / Columbus / Bloomington, quiet since 2026-03-09; Surf started Muncie and Yorktown on 2026-08-25. Stated as an exclusion rather than a city list so a NEW GBN town lands in the report on its own instead of being silently dropped. If Surf takes another Indiana town, add it here AND to Surf's cities.

Surf._note: Muncie and Yorktown ONLY, started 2026-08-25. cities and states are ANDed, so the "IN" above does not widen this to the state: it is the fence that keeps Yorktown NY (SLIC) and Yorktown VA (Glo) off Surf's report if either ever gets knocked. Shares Indiana with GBN, which carries the matching exclude_cities: add a town here and there together, or the doors get counted on both reports. SalesRabbit holds these as "Muncie" and "Yorktown"; the match is exact on a lowercased, trimmed city, so a new spelling in SR needs its own entry. Sep 18 2026: Surf also took Braidwood IL and the neighbouring Coal City / Wilmington / Diamond / Braceville doors (batch SR SURF-BRAID). IL is in states and those towns in cities, which are ANDed, so this does not widen Surf to all of Illinois; i3 keeps the rest of IL via its exclude_cities below.

Lyte._note: Texas minus Austin and Round Rock, which are Google Fiber.

GFiber._note: Missouri and Kansas, plus Austin and Round Rock TX. "also" is ORed in on top of states; Lyte carries the matching exclude_cities.

NLF._note: Canada, not a US state. SalesRabbit holds the province BOTH ways on these leads: 4,504 doors say "AB" and 2,874 say "Alberta" (counted 2026-08-21), so both spellings must stay in the list. The filter is an exact uppercased match, not a substring, and trimming this to ["AB"] silently drops 39% of the territory. Everything we knock in Canada is Alberta, so this one entry is all of Canada; add a province here if that ever changes.
